changelog: Student Fee Structure Persistence: Implemented dedicated server-side endpoint and DataContext method allowing Accountants, Admins, and Owners to persist customized per-student fee heads and amounts.

Postgres Driver & Large School Scaling (F6): Upgraded CLI backup and restore scripts to use node-postgres (pg) with SSL and 200-row transactional multi-row batch inserts, eliminating Neon serverless HTTP single-query payload limits.

Security & Load-Test Fixes (F7): Added server-side MIME and base64 format validation for school logo updates, fixed missing class_id in load-test exam result inserts, and unified backup table coverage including notifications.
Mobile Attendance Polish: Added sticky bottom save bar for mobile attendance marking.
